mbt-017.back: Old growth, and steep south to west facing slopes (90%).

mbt-018.back: Deeper than about 30 cm (90%, BC deer account).

mbt-035.front: Clearcut width that gets the most deer use?
mbt-035.back: Under 200 m wide, so under 100 m to cover from anywhere (90%).

mbt-036.front: Can you push deer with a truck?
